summary: Following its demerger from Unilever, The Magnum Ice Cream Company rebuilt its data ecosystem from the ground up. In this session, discover how Magnum built a lean, modern platform for real-time analytics and AI by unifying data in a Databricks Lakehouse. Using Fivetran to integrate SAP, Salesforce, and Workday, the team reduced complexity and costs while shifting focus from pipeline maintenance to high-impact insights and AI innovation.
